# `aitbc transactions status`

Get the status of a transaction by its hash.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc transactions status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--tx-hash` | text | — | yes | The Tx hash. |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |
| `--use-explorer` | flag | `false` | no | Use Explorer API instead of RPC |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc transactions status --tx-hash <tx_hash>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc transactions status --tx-hash <tx_hash> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
